# T4SKAG3NT 0.1.2 Foundation Preview
This validation update strengthens unattended coordination and recovery:
- Adds a destructive packaged-app restart test that proves interrupted safe work is recovered without retaining partial output. - Adds packaged coordinator delegation validation, including bounded specialist creation, linked task context, auditing, and result routing back to the parent conversation. - Adds a timed concurrency check proving that five jobs can overlap while excess work remains queued until capacity returns. - Runs lifecycle, restart recovery, delegation, and concurrency checks as part of every package verification.
This remains a Foundation Preview for controlled testing on the designated Mac mini.

# T4SKAG3NT 0.1.1 Foundation Preview
This validation update strengthens unattended application maintenance:
- Preserves the previous signed application before installing an update. - Requires a healthy relaunch receipt from the new build. - Restores the previous build automatically if the new build cannot start cleanly. - Allows a Sparkle-requested relaunch while retaining the normal “keep working” behavior for Command-Q. - Includes the signed update-recovery helper in package verification.
This remains a Foundation Preview for controlled testing on the designated Mac mini.

# T4SKAG3NT 0.1.0 Foundation Preview
This preview establishes the native Mac coordination foundation:
- Named coordinator and persistent specialist agents - Local MLX and optional OpenAI/Anthropic routing - Streaming conversations, supported attachments, and multiple windows - Background task queue with priorities, approvals, budgets, and recovery - Encrypted private state and bounded `~/Documents/T4SKAG3NT` artifacts - Health, audit, usage, model-integrity, backup, and restore controls - Signed automatic updates through Sparkle
This is a Foundation acceptance build. Remote Apple-device clients, Apple personal-service integrations, Projects, durable semantic memory, and recurring schedules remain later milestones.
